The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of PVWMH in older subjects is associated with significant alterations in water diffusion and myelin integrity, and these changes are not restricted to the PVWMH itself, but are present in the surrounding NAWM.
PVWMH is not a homogenous region, with some areas of increased myelination and reduced water diffusivity, while others have reduced myelin content and increased water diffusion.
the presence of PVWMH is not a marker of normal ageing, but rather a marker of diffuse brain pathology.
